institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Corticosteroid premedication
premedications.notes: Dexamethasone starting the day before docetaxel to reduce fluid retention and hypersensitivity, per standard taxane practice.

name: Docetaxel +/- Ramucirumab (NSCLC later line)
supportiveCare: Assess febrile-neutropenia risk; consider myeloid growth-factor support per risk framework.
Ramucirumab (antiangiogenic) may be added for suitable non-squamous patients.

drugs.name: Docetaxel
drugs.notes: Docetaxel 75 mg/m2 IV day 1, every 21 days, for fit patients after platinum chemotherapy and immunotherapy. Ramucirumab 10 mg/kg IV day 1 (antiangiogenic) may be added for eligible non-squamous patients. My own wording from standard second-line NSCLC practice.
